title: Outcomes of tofacitinib dose reduction in patients with ulcerative colitis in stable remission: a long-term follow-up of the randomized RIVETING trial
comparison_or_design: The RIVETING comparison of dose reduction to tofacitinib 5 mg twice daily and continuation of 10 mg twice daily.
observations_or_assays: Clinical response based on total Mayo score
time_scope: Month 30 only, with the original source-defined reference for clinical response.
excluded: Total-Mayo remission as a separate variant, months 6/18, subgroups and alternative Dose Group analyses
Dose-escalation remission recapture, biomarkers, time-to-event and safety
population_or_material: The full analysis set under original randomized dose assignment in RIVETING, using the reported non-responder-imputation strategy.
requested_items: Month-30 primary-imputed responder count/proportion and one CMH-weighted treatment difference/CI for each criterion. State dose direction; do not invent P values. Exclude dose-escalation response analyses and other visits.
